header.running_head: The Enthusiasm of the Sahabah (RA) to Die and Give their Lives in the path of Allaah

blocks.text: I am afraid to die." Hadhrat Khubayb (RA) was the first to start the practice of performing two Rakaahs salaah at the time of execution. He then said, "O Allaah! Do not leave any of them alive." He then recited some couplets which meant:

When I am killed as a Muslim, I care not on which side I fall
This is all for Allaah and if He wills, He could bless the severed limbs of my body
Thereafter, Uqba bin Haarith martyred him.

Because Hadhrat Aasim (RA) had killed one of the leaders of the Quraysh during the Battle of Badr, the Quraysh sent some people to bring a portion of his body to them which they may recognise as his. However, Allaah sent a swarm of wasps to his body and they protected him from the people whom the Quraysh had sent. They were therefore unable to get anything from the body.[^1]

Hadhrat Aasim bin Amr bin Qataadah reports that after the Battle of Uhud, a delegation from the Adhal and Qaara tribes came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Islaam has come to us so send with us a group of your Sahabah (RA) to make us understand the Deen, to teach us the Qur'aan and to educate us about the Shari'ah of Islaam." Rasulullaah ﷺ therefore sent with them six Sahabah (RA), whose names have been recorded.
blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Aasim bin Amr bin Qataadah

blocks.text: These Sahabah (RA) proceeded with these people until they reached Rajee, which was a well of the Hudhayl tribe situated at one end of Hijaaz where the Hada'a region commences. There the people accompanying the Sahabah (RA) betrayed them and solicited help from the Hudhayl tribe. Unaware of what was happening, the Sahabah (RA) were in their camp when they were suddenly surrounded by many men brandishing their swords. When the Sahabah (RA) grabbed their swords to fight them, the men said, "We swear by Allaah that we do not wish to kill you. All we want is to get some money from the people of Makkah in exchange for you. We give you assurance in the name of Allaah that we shall not kill you." However, Hadhrat Marthad (RA), Hadhrat Khaalid bin Bukayr (RA) and Hadhrat Aasim (RA) said, "By Allaah! We shall never ever accept a promise or pledge from a Mushrik."
The Couplets that Hadhrat Aasim (RA) Recited and His Body is Protected from the Mushrikeen
Hadhrat Aasim (RA) then recited some couplets which meant:

"Far from being a sick man, I am a powerful archer
And my bow has a sturdy string
Arrows with long and wide shafts glide over it
Death is true whereas life is a fake
Whatever Allaah has destined will certainly happen to a man
And man will have to return to Him
May my mother forsake me if I do not fight you"
Bukhari, Bayhaqi (Vol.9 Pg.145), Abdur Razzaaq (as quoted in Isti'aab Vol.3 Pg.132) and Abu Nu'aym in Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.112).
